  native:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.14.4'
      - name: Install qualified Clang 20 native execution prerequisites
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl --fail --location --retry 3 --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-llvm.asc" https://apt.llvm.org/llvm-snapshot.gpg.key
          fingerprint=$(gpg --show-keys --with-colons "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-llvm.asc" | awk -F: '$1 == "fpr" { print $10; exit }')
          test "$fingerprint" = 6084F3CF814B57C1CF12EFD515CF4D18AF4F7421
          sudo install -m 0644 "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-llvm.asc" /usr/share/keyrings/hia-llvm.asc
          printf '%s\n' 'deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/hia-llvm.asc] https://apt.llvm.org/noble/ llvm-toolchain-noble-20 main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/hia-llvm20.list
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y binutils gcc clang-20 libclang-rt-20-dev strace
          printf 'CLANG=/usr/bin/clang-20\nHEPTA_CLANG=/usr/bin/clang-20\n' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - run: python -m pip install setuptools==78.1.1 wheel==0.46.3 z3-solver==4.15.4.0 jsonschema==4.26.0
      - run: python -B tools/replay_hia_selfhost_cold.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-cold.json"
      - run: python -B tests/test_hia_selfhost_language_coverage.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-language.json"
      - name: Native linked loader and compiler receipt bindings
        run: |
          python -B - <<'PYBINDINGS'
          from hashlib import sha256
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import unittest
          from tools.build_hia_json_preflight import admit_cold_build
          cold_path = Path(os.environ['HEPTA_HIA_LINKED_OBSERVER_COLD_REPORT'])
          cold_bytes = cold_path.read_bytes()
          cold = json.loads(cold_bytes)
          nested_bytes = Path(cold['nested_report']).read_bytes()
          if sha256(nested_bytes).hexdigest() != cold['nested_report_sha256']:
              raise ValueError('current cold nested report changed before receipt controls')
          nested = json.loads(nested_bytes)
          compiler = Path(nested['generations'][-1]['produced_image'])
          compiler_bytes = compiler.read_bytes()
          admit_cold_build(compiler_bytes, cold_bytes)
          os.environ['HEPTA_HIA_COMPILE_RECEIPT_COMPILER'] = str(compiler)
          os.environ['HEPTA_HIA_COMPILE_RECEIPT_COMPILER_SHA256'] = sha256(compiler_bytes).hexdigest()
          names = (
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost_linked_observer.LinkedObserverNativeTests',
              'tests.test_hia_original_select_fragments.CompleteOutputObservationTests',
              'tests.test_hia_compile_receipt_binding.CompileReceiptNativeTests',
          )
          suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames(names)
          if suite.countTestCases() != 37:
              raise AssertionError('complete linked-loader and receipt control inventory changed')
          result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
          unchanged = (compiler.read_bytes() == compiler_bytes
                       and cold_path.read_bytes() == cold_bytes
                       and Path(cold['nested_report']).read_bytes() == nested_bytes)
          passed = (result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun == 37 and unchanged
                    and not result.skipped and not result.expectedFailures
                    and not result.unexpectedSuccesses)
          raise SystemExit(0 if passed else 1)
          PYBINDINGS
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_LINKED_OBSERVER_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
          HEPTA_HIA_LINKED_OBSERVER_EVIDENCE: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-linked-observer
          HEPTA_HIA_COMPILE_RECEIPT_OBSERVATIONS: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-compile-receipts
      - name: Native applications and actual Core memory controls
        run: |
          python -B - <<'PYTEST'
          import unittest
          names = (
              'tests.test_hia_agent_stdio',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_snapshot_native',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_snapshot_json_native',
              'tests.test_hia_core_json_cli',
              'tests.test_hia_elf_linker',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_identity_native',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_slice_native',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_installed_resources',
              'tests.test_hia_native_child_limits',
              'tests.test_hia_native_seccomp',
              'tests.test_hia_native_side_effects',
              'tests.test_hia_native_cleanup',
              'tests.test_hia_native_mapping_identity',
              'tests.test_hia_native_startup_isolation',
              'tests.test_hia_json_preflight_native',
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost_emitter_words',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_admission_transaction',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_borrow_admission',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_borrow_rollback_receipt',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_completed_pin_retirement',

              'tests.test_hia_host_region_prestart_pin_release_receipt',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_prestart_retirement_receipt',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_public_release_receipt',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_quarantine_receipt',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_race',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_recovery_mprotect_receipt',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_recovery_receipt',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_recovery_snapshot',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_recovery_zero_fault',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_write_receipt',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_data_json_native',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_binary64_native',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_binary64_format_native',
          )
          result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames(names))
          raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() and not result.skipped and not result.expectedFailures else 1)
          PYTEST
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_AGENT_STDIO_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
          HEPTA_HIA_AGENT_IDENTITY_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
      - name: Native Core module graph and actual workspace projects
        run: python -B -m unittest tests.test_hia_core_module_graph_native -v
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_CORE_MODULE_GRAPH_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
          HEPTA_HIA_CORE_MODULE_GRAPH_OBSERVATIONS: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-module-projects
      - name: Native Core workspace JSON materialization and actual ABI
        run: python -B -m unittest tests.test_hia_core_workspace_json_native tests.test_hia_core_workspace_json_cli tests.test_hia_core_workspace_pipeline -v
        env:

      - name: Native Core capability edge policy and actual CFG
        run: python -B -m unittest tests.test_hia_capability_renaming_native -v
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_CAPABILITY_RENAMING_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
      - name: Native explicit workspace facts and semantic ELF materialization

        env:

      - name: Native full Core function declarations SSA and CFG

        env:

      - name: Native whole primitive Core declaration SSA CFG and export admission

        env:

      - name: Native streaming SHA complete retained state controls
        run: |
          python -B - <<'PYSTREAM'
          import unittest
          suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName('tests.test_hia_sha256_stream_native')
          if suite.countTestCases() != 9:
              raise AssertionError('complete streaming SHA control inventory changed')
